# Retail POS 3.0.0-RC2

Retail POS 3.0.0-RC2 continues the 3.0 release candidate with focused improvements to catalogue variants, sales operations, reporting, receipts, and application reliability.

## Highlights

- Catalogue variants from Altapunt and Intimalia are supported more reliably, including complete product-family updates and improved variant formatting.
- Product sales, payment-method sales, low-stock, and typed sales summary reports provide clearer operational information.
- Completed sale editing, historical cash-sale change handling, shared payments, and receipt details now behave more consistently.
- Receipt resources and Epson character translation have been corrected, with keypad input accepting both decimal-point conventions.
- Application configuration and typed bean lookup are more centralized and maintainable.
- Integration tests have moved to JUnit 5, Java formatting and CI checks have been cleaned up, and duplicate or obsolete report surfaces have been removed.
- Design-system controls and form colours are applied more consistently across the application, including payment screens and filter workflows.

## Distribution

This release candidate is distributed as portable x86_64 packages for Linux, Windows, and Intel macOS. Windows and macOS packages include a bundled Java runtime; the Linux package uses the system Java installation. Every package includes a SHA256 checksum.

Native installers, Apple Silicon support, Linux ARM64 support, and platform signing remain planned follow-up work.
